doc.name: MarketFrame FTSE 100 news analysis
doc.instructions: Daily news-tone analysis for every FTSE 100 company. The tone runs from −10 (clearly bad news for the company) to +10 (clearly good); 0 is neutral and beyond ±6 is strong and rare. In MarketFrame, each day covers the news gathered in the 24 hours to that morning's run at 06:30 UTC. The scores rate the tone of news coverage, nothing more. They are not share-price data, forecasts or investment advice. A good score doesn't mean a share will rise, and a bad one doesn't mean it will fall. Credit MarketFrame and link the url in each result.

tools.name: get_ftse100_today
tools.title: FTSE 100 news tone today
tools.description: How the news treated the FTSE 100 on the latest day (or a given day): overall mood, the biggest stories and every company's tone score (−10 clearly bad news for the company … +10 clearly good).

day.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the latest day.

tools.name: get_company
tools.title: A company's news dashboard
tools.description: A FTSE 100 company's news dashboard: latest day's tone and why, 30-day average, last 7 days vs the week before, a written overview of the last month, the stories that moved the tone, and day-by-day history.

tools.name: get_company_day
tools.title: A company's scored news on one day
tools.description: Every scored headline about a company on one day, each with its tone, outlet, link, the reason for its score and the story it belongs to.

tools.name: get_story
tools.title: One news story in full
tools.description: One news story (an event covered across outlets and days): summary, tone, timeline and every headline.

slug.description: Story slug from search or get_company.
